name: Telegram Bridge
description: Two-way Telegram bot bridge that routes messages to your Orca bots and sends replies back.

statusBarItems.tooltip: Telegram Bridge status (click to toggle polling)

settings.title: Enable Telegram Polling
settings.description: Keep polling Telegram for incoming messages while Orca is running.

settings.title: Default Orca Bot
settings.description: Default Orca bot name to route Telegram messages to (leave blank for auto: use the first available bot).

settings.title: Allowed Telegram User IDs
settings.description: Comma-separated numeric Telegram user IDs allowed to drive your Orca bots.

settings.title: HTTP Proxy URL
settings.description: Optional HTTP proxy for api.telegram.org (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:7890).

settings.title: Reply Timeout (seconds)
settings.description: Maximum seconds to wait for an Orca bot reply.

settings.title: Sync Orca Messages to Telegram
settings.description: Forward messages sent in Orca and bot replies from bound chats back to Telegram.

settings.title: Telegram Reply Language
settings.description: Language of the bridge's own Telegram replies and command menu: en (English), pt-BR (Português do Brasil) or zh-CN (中文). Bot replies are not translated.

settings.title: Debug Logging
settings.description: Record detailed debug entries (Telegram and Orca CLI calls with timings, dispatch steps, swallowed errors) in the Logs tab. Tokens are redacted.
